title: Tell main when a worker finishes
notes: The Stop hook's notify done only marks the pane. Queue a short message into main's SDK session (chat-decision-7 queue) for panes main dispatched. Cost small to medium. (docs/review/2026-11-01.md W4)

comments.body: Shipped in #176: a done from main's own worker queues a prompt naming the worker and its pane link into the dispatching main's session.
